name: school_interior_studentdesk
description: A snug cluster of student desks in the Greek classroom, arranged for collaborative learning near sunlit windows.

color_palette: Soft blue (#ADD8E6) for nearby walls and window frames to keep the space calm and breezy.
Warm yellow (#FFD700) for chair cushions and small organizers to add cheerful energy and focus.
Rich green (#228B22) for pencil caddies and rug borders to suggest growth and learning.
visual_style.architectural_style: Simple Mediterranean schoolhouse details with whitewashed walls, exposed wooden beams, and low ceilings. The desk area sits beside large, shuttered windows that open toward the courtyard.
visual_style.furniture: Small honey-colored oak desks with blue-painted trim are paired in neat rows to form islands for two to four students. Matching low chairs with warm yellow seat pads tuck under each desk, and a woven green-and-cream caddy sits at the center of each island.
materials: Honey oak desks with blue-painted trim
Stone floor with a woven geometric rug
